raw_text: Wagner-linked channels are celebrating the Niger coup. Multiple Telegram channels associated with the group are sharing pro-CNSP content and framing the takeover as liberation from French neo-colonialism. Sources indicate Wagner operatives already present in neighboring Mali may be preparing to offer military advisory services to the new junta. The anti-France protests in Niamey appear partially organized through these channels.
